articles.title: Drew Rasmussen's Yankees mastery continues in Game 1. 'Dialed in' Rays ace looks untouchable
articles.description: Rasmussen is a pitching savant. He pours over scouting reports. He obsesses over pitch sequences.

articles.title: The numbers say Yankees can't afford to lose Game 2. There are reasons to think they won't
articles.description: Freddy Peralta offers interesting lineup possibilities for Aaron Boone. The Yankees will need to solve him to avoid a difficult 0-2 deficit.

articles.title: Yankees’ Austin Wells missed the stop sign in costly base-running blunder: ‘The risk was wrong’
articles.description: "Just obviously not a good decision,” Aaron Boone said of Wells' attempt to stretch a double into a triple in the eighth in a 1-0 game.

articles.title: Rays ride Drew Rasmussen's no-hit bid to Game 1 win. Can Yankees' bats bounce back?
articles.description: Rasmussen threw 7 2/3 innings of no-hit ball and struck out 10 in a dominant performance that stymied the Yankees' offense.

articles.title: Three years after sparse crowds in playoffs, Rays draw packed house vs. Yankees
articles.description: "I've never seen it like this," Florida resident and Rays fan Ray Crawford, 43, said Saturday at Tropicana Field. "This is crazy."

articles.title: Aaron Judge not on Yankees' ALDS roster vs. Rays, but Ryan Weathers added to pen
articles.description: Judge (calf sprain) also wasn’t on the roster for the Wild Card Series vs. Boston this week. Weathers adds a new option out of the bullpen.

articles.title: Division Series predictions: Can the Yankees take down the Rays? Will the Dodgers advance?
articles.description: The Rays, Brewers and Guardians have first-round byes or home-field edges, but not everyone on the staff is buying it.

articles.title: The hidden reason behind the Yankees choosing Gerrit Cole to start Game 1 of the ALDS
articles.description: The Yankees said the decision to have Cole start Game 1 was "easy," but the reasons were fairly complex.

articles.title: Will Aaron Judge play for Yankees in ALDS vs. Rays? It seems unlikely
articles.description: The New York slugger took batting practice a day ahead of Saturday's Game 1, but he didn't run on the Tropicana Field turf.

articles.title: 2026 World Series odds: Dodgers still favored, but Yankees now in top spot for AL pennant
articles.description: As the Division Series start, the Dodgers remain the clear favorites to win the World Series. The Yankees vaulted the Rays as AL favorite.

articles.title: Yankees ALDS roster projection: Gerrit Cole goes in Game 1; Aaron Judge expected to be out
articles.description: The Yankees are coming off a wild-card sweep of Boston and will be going into Game 1 with two days off. Who will be on their ALDS roster?

articles.title: Yankees vs. Rays ALDS predictions: Ben Rice, Cam Schlittler and the matchups that could decide the series
articles.description: Can the Yankees solve their Drew Rasmussen problem? Can the Rays keep Ben Rice from doing damage? Here's what our writers will be watching.

articles.title: As Yankees advance to ALDS, how much credit does Aaron Boone deserve for this season?
articles.description: What kind of job has Boone done, so far, managing the Yankees this season? His players say he deserves more credit than some fans give him.

articles.title: For Yankees, beating top-seeded Rays should be their ticket back to World Series
articles.description: Tampa Bay should represent a much bigger obstacle than either team the Yankees could face in the ALCS, if they advance.

articles.title: It’s high time the Yankees follow the Knicks’ lead in New York
articles.description: “We’re definitely inspired by the Knicks,” Yankees slugger Aaron Judge said, “and we’ve got to keep the winning going in New York.”

articles.title: Yankees bounce Boston again, routing their rivals and advancing to face Rays in ALDS
articles.description: The Yankees overwhelmed the Red Sox, outscoring their rivals 18-2 over two games. Next up: Game 1 of the ALDS against Tampa Bay on Saturday.

articles.title: A Yankees bullpen catcher took Ben Rice's grand slam off his head. The viral moment was planned
articles.description: Rather than catching Rice's Game 1 grand slam, Rainiero Coa let the ball hit him in the face mask, creating a viral moment.

articles.title: Yankees torture the Red Sox again, thanks to the Mass. appeal of Schlittler, Rice
articles.description: Two kids from Massachusetts are playing Turn Back the Clock with the Red Sox-Yankees rivalry.

articles.title: Ben Rice wasn't supposed to be here. Now the Yankees can't live without him
articles.description: Rice, a 12th round draft pick, became the first player in Yankees history to collect at least four hits and six RBIs in a postseason game.

articles.title: These Yankees can win a championship, with or without Aaron Judge
articles.description: The Yankees didn't need their captain yet, not with Cam Schlittler and Ben Rice dominating in a Game 1 rout of the Red Sox.
